repo_notes.content: Document the current main-branch implementation, not assumptions from the README. Source files take precedence over project descriptions. Distinguish implemented, partial, legacy and planned features. Cite exact source paths and symbols. Pay special attention to cryptographic key lifecycles, SQLCipher migration safety, Android credential provider capabilities, backup compatibility and security limitations. Never describe a security mechanism as independently audited without evidence. Use concise technical English, Mermaid diagrams where useful, and cross-links between related pages.
